name: Ghost Crawler

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (silk threads soaked in wine); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Ephemeral Body
traits.summary: Squeezes through gaps an inch wide at no extra cost.
traits.text: The crawler moves through spaces as narrow as an inch without paying extra movement.

traits.name: Seer's Strand
traits.summary: Sees and hears through the space of its Ether Webs as if it stood there.
traits.text: The crawler sees and hears through any space holding its Ether Webs as if it were in that space (a special sense).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The crawler climbs difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.summary: Ignores web movement limits and knows where any creature touching the same web is.
traits.text: The crawler ignores movement restrictions from webs and knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: +5, 1d4+3 Piercing; the target is Poisoned until the crawler's next turn.

actions.name: Ether Webs
actions.summary: Twice a day: fills a 5-ft cube with invisible webs for 8 hours (collapses if not anchored between solid masses or across a surface); the crawler knows where anyone touching them is, on the same plane.
actions.text: The crawler fills a 5-foot cube with Invisible, ephemeral webs that last 8 hours. Webs not anchored between two solid masses (walls, trees) or layered over a floor, wall or ceiling collapse and vanish. Whenever a creature touches the webbing, the crawler knows where that creature is for as long as they share a plane.

summary: A ghostly spider that bites with poison and lays invisible webs it can see through, a camp alarm and scout.
